name: compute_molecular_fingerprint_similarity
description: Compute the similarity between two molecules using their molecular fingerprints. Use this tool to compare how similar two chemical compounds are based on their SMILES representations.

parameters.name: smiles_a
parameters.description: SMILES string of the first molecule.

parameters.name: smiles_b
parameters.description: SMILES string of the second molecule.
